drivers: Scattered refinery outages (Deer Park, HPCL Vizag) offset by coker restarts (Flint Hills, MOL Rijeka)
Petcoke rally above US$100 in October, but price is down 16% over 3 months
US heavy oil glut from freight squeeze
outlooks.summary: Refinery news is mixed: some outages, but also coker restarts and limited impact from fires and storms. The supply-pressure score is near zero, and the price has fallen over 3 months, so there is no clear shortage signal.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch coker run rates at US Gulf Coast and Indian refineries and whether freight rates ease.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂消息好坏参半:有部分停产,但也有焦化装置重启,火灾和风暴影响有限。供应压力得分接近零,且价格3个月内下跌,没有明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: Deer Park、HPCL Vizag炼厂出现零星停产,但Flint Hills、MOL Rijeka焦化装置已重启
10月石油焦一度升破100美元,但3个月内价格下跌16%
运费上涨导致美国重质原油过剩
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注美国墨西哥湾沿岸和印度炼厂的焦化装置开工率,以及运费是否回落。

drivers: DRC export quotas cut Glencore cobalt output by 52%
Chinese miner suspends DR Congo operations
China export-control pause nearing its deadline
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are clearly cutting supply, and a Chinese miner has suspended operations in Congo. Price is down 24% over 3 months but up 26% over 12 months, so further upside is plausible if quotas keep biting.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and any restart of the suspended Congo operations.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额明显压低供应,一家中资矿企已暂停在刚果的业务。价格3个月下跌24%,12个月上涨26%,若配额持续收紧,进一步上行可能性较大。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额使嘉能可钴产量下降52%
中资矿企暂停刚果(金)业务
中国出口管制暂停期临近截止
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整情况,以及被暂停业务能否恢复。

drivers: Copper-moly giant slows molybdenum output growth
China export-control pause nearing its deadline
Record-low TCs and war-hit supply chains
outlooks.summary: Supply growth is slowing and policy risk from China is rising. Price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months, so part of this is priced in, but the supply-pressure score is the highest of the group's metals bar tin.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and output guidance from major copper-moly producers.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应增长放缓,且中国政策风险上升。价格3个月已涨18%、12个月涨42%,部分利多已被消化,但供应压力得分较高。
drivers_zh: 铜钼龙头企业放缓钼产量增长
中国出口管制暂停期临近截止
加工费创历史新低、受战争影响的供应链
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定以及主要铜钼生产商的产量指引。

drivers: Zimbabwe maintains January 2027 lithium export ban
China export-control pause nearing its deadline
CATL expanding upstream lithium capacity
outlooks.summary: Zimbabwe's export ban adds some supply risk, but most other headlines are generic critical-mineral news. Price is down 13% in 3 months, and new upstream projects offset some concern.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Zimbabwe's export ban implementation and China's export-control decision.
outlooks.summary_zh: 津巴布韦的出口禁令增加了一定供应风险,但其他多为泛关键矿产新闻。价格3个月下跌13%,上游新项目也部分抵消了担忧。
drivers_zh: 津巴布韦维持2027年1月锂出口禁令
中国出口管制暂停期临近截止
宁德时代扩大上游锂资源布局
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦禁令的落实情况以及中国出口管制的决定。

drivers: Japan yttrium supplies 'stalled' under Chinese export controls
China extended export-control pause to January 2027
Mixed signals on whether the extension is formal
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages in Japan show real supply stress, but China's two-month extension of the pause eases near-term risk. Price is up 36% over 12 months, so risk remains skewed up, especially for heavy rare earths.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China formally confirms the extension and what happens before the January 2027 deadline.
outlooks.summary_zh: 日本钇供应紧张显示供应压力真实存在,但中国将暂停期延长两个月,缓解了近期风险。价格12个月上涨36%,风险仍偏向上行,尤其是重稀土。
drivers_zh: 日本钇供应在中国出口管制下“停滞”
中国将出口管制暂停期延长至2027年1月
对延期是否正式生效信号不一
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国是否正式确认延期,以及2027年1月截止日前的动向。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
Tin demand growth outpacing refined supply
Chip demand strong
outlooks.summary: Supply disruption in Congo and Indonesia is meeting strong demand, and the supply-pressure score is high at +0.50. Price is up 56% over 12 months but flat over 3 months, so further upside looks possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Bisie (Congo) output and Indonesian export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)和印尼的供应中断叠加需求强劲,供应压力得分高达+0.50。价格12个月上涨56%,但近3个月持平,进一步上行仍有可能。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
锡需求增长超过精炼锡供应
芯片需求强劲
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)Bisie矿产量和印尼出口量。

drivers: Antimony export deadline nearing
China export-control pause nearing its deadline
Price down 56% over 12 months
outlooks.summary: An export deadline is a possible risk, but the headlines are mostly generic and the price is weak, down 56% over a year. No clear shortage signal yet.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline and any Chinese policy decision.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口截止日期是潜在风险,但相关新闻多为泛泛内容,且价格疲软,12个月下跌56%。目前尚无明确的短缺信号。
drivers_zh: 锑出口截止日期临近
中国出口管制暂停期临近截止
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口截止日期以及中国的政策决定。

drivers: China November 27 gallium deadline and export-control risk
Rising indium prices and tight minor-metal supply
Strong chip and GaN demand
outlooks.summary: Policy deadlines and tight minor-metal supply point to more upside risk. However, price is already up 67% in 3 months, so some of the shortage is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and any new export-license rules.
outlooks.summary_zh: 政策截止日期和小金属供应偏紧显示上行风险。但价格3个月已上涨67%,部分短缺预期已被消化。
drivers_zh: 中国11月27日镓相关截止日期及出口管制风险
铟价上涨,小金属供应偏紧
芯片和氮化镓需求强劲
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国11月27日的截止日期以及新的出口许可规定。

drivers: Mixed refinery outages and coker restarts
Feedstock rally lifting China prebaked anode above RMB 6,000
Freight squeeze on US exports
outlooks.summary: Supply news is mixed and the score is near zero. Price is up 15% over 3 months, and the anode-cost rally suggests demand-driven strength rather than a clear shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch GPC prices and Chinese anode demand for signs of tight feedstock.
outlooks.summary_zh: 供应消息好坏参半,得分接近零。价格3个月上涨15%,阳极成本上涨更像是需求带动的走强,而非明确短缺。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与焦化装置重启并存
原料上涨推动中国预焙阳极升破6000元/吨
运费挤压美国出口
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注生焦价格和中国阳极需求,判断原料是否趋紧。

drivers: Mixed refinery outages and restarts
Petcoke rally above US$100 in October
Price down 5% over 3 months
outlooks.summary: Headlines show no clear shortage; outages are offset by restarts. The index is up 46% over 12 months but down 5% over 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery coker outages and freight rates for US petcoke exports.
outlooks.summary_zh: 新闻未显示明确短缺,停产被重启抵消。指数12个月上涨46%,但3个月下跌5%。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与重启并存
10月石油焦一度升破100美元
价格3个月下跌5%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注炼厂焦化装置停产情况以及美国石油焦出口运费。
